# CreateFrame
| Swogstun | Automated updating of API pages at this location, to reflect patch changes, has ceased from 10.1.7 onwards. |
Creates a Frame object.
```
frame = CreateFrame(frameType [, name, parent, template, id])
```

## Arguments [ [](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwowpedia.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FAPI_CreateFrame%3Faction%3Dedit%26section%3D1&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit") ]
```
frameType
string \- Type of the frame; e.g. "Frame" or "Button".
```

...

🔗 - Parent object to assign to the frame, or `nil` to be parentless; cannot be a string.
Can also be set with Region:SetParent ()
template
string ?
- Comma-delimited list of virtual XML templates to inherit; see also a [complete
list](https://github.com/Ketho/BlizzardInterfaceResources/blob/mainline/Resources/Templates.lua) of FrameXML
templates.
id
number ? - ID to assign to the frame. Can also be set with Frame:SetID ()

...

## Details [ [](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwowpedia.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FAPI_CreateFrame%3Faction%3Dedit%26section%3D4&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit") ]
* Fires the frame's OnLoad script, if it has one from an inherited template.

...

## Example [ [](https://auth.fandom.com/signin?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwowpedia.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FAPI_CreateFrame%3Faction%3Dedit%26section%3D5&uselang=en&metadata=article-registration-edit-article-section "Sign in to edit") ]
```
local f = CreateFrame ( "Frame" , nil , UIParent ) 
 f : SetPoint ( "CENTER" ) 
 f : SetSize ( 64 , 64 ) 

```
